title: QuestionPresentationV2
description: Complete render-only question descriptors bound to the authoritative raw question. The selection object describes the total number of non-completion picks a client may/must submit across repeated Answer envelopes for this question; choices marked completesSelection finish early and do not count toward that total. Clients answer with the documented envelope and presented sourceIndex values; the server remains the legality authority.

value.description: Campaign/scenario-specific settings are card- or campaign-owned JSON blobs; their inner shape is intentionally opaque to the generic presentation contract.

selection.description: Total number of non-completion picks across repeated Answer submissions for this question.
